title: Untitled: SIR WILLIAM GOOCH, governor of Williamsburg,…
text: SIR WILLIAM GOOCH, governor of Williamsburg, walking along the street with a friend, returned the salute of a negro servant who was passing by; "I see," said his friend, "you condescend to take notice of a slave." "Yes" replied Sir William, "for I cannot allow even a slave to excel mo in good manners."
